decision: NX-056 (docs/design/unified-approvals.md v5 §3, §10; owner 2026-10-22 Q1 option A, ADR-039): the first three capabilities that need a second person's approval before they run - real_dispatch.set only when it opens (enabled=true; closing is never held), consumer.erase started by the owner (a Consumer's own request is confirmed through consumer.erase_on_request and is not held), and retention.release_hold. Quorum 1, approvers are owners, never the requester (by subject), 24 hours to decide and execute. A new Action version without a policy version for it is refused until this file follows. Applied by the technical configurator (control.nexloop_configure_approval_policies); policies are append-only. Summary fields name no Consumer identifier and no free text (the approver sees the digest and these fields only). expected_revision is the last applied manifest version (0 before the first); the database records each applied file's sha256. v2 (NX-058 slice D2, docs/design/nx058-owner-actions.md §1): the owner-only member Actions promote_owner, demote_owner, suspend_owner, resume_owner and revoke_owner - no condition, quorum 1, approved by another owner (never the requester, never the member the request acts on: target_subject_field target_principal), single-person mode not applicable, 24 hours. The approver sees the member through the approval view's target_member (ADR-039 R1 §6), never a summary field; demote_owner shows new_role. Each handler refuses unless its policy has exactly this shape. Publish the Actions before applying this file.

policies.purpose: Opening a real dispatch switch is the last step before external effects; closing runs at once.
An erasure the owner starts is irreversible; a Consumer's own request goes through consumer.erase_on_request.
Releasing a hold lets retention and erasure delete what it kept.
NX-058 slice D: an owner-only member change; another owner approves it.
